grammar_topic.name: Present Continuous
grammar_topic.rule: am/is/are + V-ing. Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Is university education really necessary to become successful?
days.speaking_debate: Would you rather be rich without happiness or happy without money?

grammar_topic.name: Present Simple
grammar_topic.rule: V1 yoki V+s/es. Odatlar, kundalik ishlar va umumiy haqiqatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Social media: Does it make young people smarter or more distracted?
days.speaking_debate: Can a person live a happy life without social media?

grammar_topic.name: Present Continuous and Present Simple 1
grammar_topic.rule: Present Simple odatiy harakatlar, Present Continuous ayni paytdagi yoki vaqtinchalik harakatlar uchun.

days.writing_topic: Online education vs traditional university education.
days.speaking_debate: Are online classes better than studying in a real classroom?

grammar_topic.name: Present Continuous and Present Simple 2
grammar_topic.rule: Holat fe'llari (know, believe, understand, want) odatda Continuous shaklida ishlatilmaydi.

days.writing_topic: Do smartphones make people less intelligent?
days.speaking_debate: Could you live for 30 days without your smartphone?

grammar_topic.name: Past Simple
grammar_topic.rule: V2 yoki did + V1. O'tmishda tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: The most important lesson young men should learn before turning 25.
days.speaking_debate: Is it better to learn from your own mistakes or other people's mistakes?

grammar_topic.name: Past Continuous
grammar_topic.rule: was/were + V-ing. O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: How has technology changed our childhood?
days.speaking_debate: Was life better before the internet?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect 1
grammar_topic.rule: have/has + V3. O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, hozirgi natijasi yoki ahamiyati bor harakatlar.

days.writing_topic: Five experiences every young man should have before the age of 25.
days.speaking_debate: Is travelling more valuable than buying expensive things?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect 2
grammar_topic.rule: Already, yet, just, ever va never Present Perfect bilan ko'p ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Is money the most important factor in choosing a career?
days.speaking_debate: Would you choose a high salary or a job you love?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar_topic.rule: have/has been + V-ing. O'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Why is self-discipline more important than motivation?
days.speaking_debate: Can discipline make an average person successful?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect Continuous and Simple
grammar_topic.rule: Perfect Simple natija yoki miqdorga, Perfect Continuous esa jarayon va davomiylikka urg'u beradi.

days.writing_topic: Reading books vs watching educational videos: Which is more effective?
days.speaking_debate: Can YouTube replace traditional education?

grammar_topic.name: How long have you (been)...?
grammar_topic.rule: How long bilan davomiylik so'raladi. Have you known yoki Have you been working kabi shakllar ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: How can young people use their time more effectively?
days.speaking_debate: Is waking up at 5 AM the secret to success?

grammar_topic.name: For and Since
grammar_topic.rule: For vaqt davomiyligi bilan, Since esa boshlanish nuqtasi bilan ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: The importance of learning English in the modern world.
days.speaking_debate: Is English more important than learning programming?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect and Past Simple 1
grammar_topic.rule: Present Perfect aniq tugagan vaqtni ko'rsatmaydi; Past Simple esa tugagan vaqt bilan ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Has the younger generation become more ambitious than previous generations?
days.speaking_debate: Are today's young people more successful than their parents were?

grammar_topic.name: Present Perfect and Past Simple 2
grammar_topic.rule: Been to tashrif buyurib qaytganlikni, gone to esa biror joyga ketganlikni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Should young people move abroad to build a better future?
days.speaking_debate: Would you leave your country if you got a great job abroad?

grammar_topic.name: Past Perfect
grammar_topic.rule: had + V3. O'tmishdagi boshqa bir hodisadan oldin sodir bo'lgan ishni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: One mistake that can completely change a person's future.
days.speaking_debate: Can one bad decision destroy a successful future?

grammar_topic.name: Past Perfect Continuous
grammar_topic.rule: had been + V-ing. O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtgacha davom etgan jarayonni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Why do some talented people fail while ordinary people succeed?
days.speaking_debate: Is hard work more important than natural talent?

grammar_topic.name: Have and Have Got
grammar_topic.rule: Have/Have got egalikni, shuningdek ayrim holat va munosabatlarni ifodalaydi.

days.writing_topic: What makes a man truly successful: money, knowledge or character?
days.speaking_debate: Does a successful man need to be financially rich?

grammar_topic.name: Used to
grammar_topic.rule: Used to + V1. O'tmishda odat bo'lgan, hozir esa mavjud bo'lmagan holat yoki harakat.

days.writing_topic: How has modern life changed family relationships?
days.speaking_debate: Were people happier 50 years ago than they are today?

grammar_topic.name: Present Tenses for the Future
grammar_topic.rule: Present Continuous kelishilgan rejalar, Present Simple esa jadval va rasmiy vaqtlar uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Where do you see yourself in ten years?
days.speaking_debate: Should young people plan their entire future before the age of 25?

grammar_topic.name: Going to
grammar_topic.rule: am/is/are going to + V1. Oldindan qilingan reja va mavjud dalilga asoslangan taxmin uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Will artificial intelligence take away most human jobs?
days.speaking_debate: Will AI make programmers unnecessary in the future?

grammar_topic.name: Will and Shall 1
grammar_topic.rule: Will + V1. Tezkor qarorlar, va'dalar, takliflar va kelajak haqidagi taxminlar uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Will robots become better workers than humans?
days.speaking_debate: Should robots replace humans in dangerous jobs?

grammar_topic.name: Will and Shall 2
grammar_topic.rule: Will kelajakdagi holat va fikrlarni ifodalaydi; Shall I...? taklif qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Is marriage still important for young people in the modern world?
days.speaking_debate: Is it better to get married young or build a career first?

bonus_idiom.translation: Men ham qatnashaman! / Meni ham qo'sh!

grammar_topic.name: I Will and I'm Going To
grammar_topic.rule: Will tezkor qaror uchun, Going to esa oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish uchun ishlatiladi.

days.writing_topic: Should university students work while studying?
days.speaking_debate: Is earning money during university more important than getting excellent grades?

grammar_topic.name: Will Be Doing and Will Have Done
grammar_topic.rule: Future Continuous kelajakdagi jarayonni, Future Perfect esa ma'lum vaqtgacha tugallangan ishni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: How will technology change our daily lives by 2040?
days.speaking_debate: Will people become more intelligent or more dependent on technology?

bonus_idiom.translation: Gapimni eslab qol! / Aytganimni eslab qo'y!

grammar_topic.name: When I Do and When I've Done
grammar_topic.rule: Kelajak ma'nosidagi when, if, before, after kabi ergash gaplarda odatda will ishlatilmaydi.

days.writing_topic: Should people follow their dreams even when their families disagree?
days.speaking_debate: Would you choose your parents' expectations or your personal dreams?

grammar_topic.name: Can, Could and Be Able To
grammar_topic.rule: Can hozirgi qobiliyat, Could o'tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat, Be able to esa turli zamonlarda qobiliyatni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Can a person become successful without a university degree?
days.speaking_debate: Are practical skills more valuable than academic knowledge?

grammar_topic.name: Could and Could Have Done
grammar_topic.rule: Could + V1 imkoniyat yoki qobiliyatni, Could have + V3 esa o'tmishda amalga oshmagan imkoniyatni bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Do people regret the opportunities they did not take?
days.speaking_debate: Is taking risks better than living a safe and comfortable life?

grammar_topic.name: Must and Can't
grammar_topic.rule: Must kuchli mantiqiy xulosani, Can't esa biror narsaning mumkin emasligi haqidagi xulosani bildiradi.

days.writing_topic: Should success be measured by money or by personal achievements?
days.speaking_debate: Can money buy happiness?

grammar_topic.name: May and Might 1
grammar_topic.rule: May va Might ehtimollikni bildiradi. Might odatda ehtimol biroz kuchsizroq ekanini anglatishi mumkin.

days.writing_topic: Will studying abroad guarantee a better future?
days.speaking_debate: Is it worth leaving your home country to achieve your dreams?

grammar_topic.name: May and Might 2
grammar_topic.rule: May/Might + have + V3 o'tmishdagi ehtimoliy voqeani bildiradi. May/Might + V1 kelajakdagi ehtimolni ifodalaydi.

days.writing_topic: What does it really mean to be a successful man in the 21st century?
days.speaking_debate: If you could change one thing about the world, what would it be and why?

daily_rules.grammar: Har kuni Murphy kitobidan tegishli Unitni o'qish va barcha mashqlarni bajarish.
daily_rules.writing: Har bir talaba 150-200 so'zli mustaqil insho yozadi.
daily_rules.idioms: Har kuni yangi iborani yodlash va kamida 3 ta gapda ishlatish.
daily_rules.vocabulary: Har kuni 10-15 ta yangi so'z o'rganish.
daily_rules.listening: Har kuni 15 daqiqa inglizcha video yoki film tomosha qilish.
daily_rules.reading: Har kuni 10-15 daqiqa inglizcha matn o'qish.

weekly_challenges.challenge: O'zingiz, kundalik hayotingiz va o'tmishdagi tajribangiz haqida 3 daqiqa gapirish.
Present Perfect va Past Perfect yordamida hayotiy voqealarni hikoya qilish.
Kelajakdagi rejalar va orzular haqida 5 daqiqa gapirish.
Murakkab mavzuda fikr bildirish, dalillar keltirish va qarshi fikrga javob berish.

final_exam.speaking: 5 daqiqalik mustaqil nutq va 10 daqiqalik guruh bahsi.
final_exam.listening: 10 daqiqalik inglizcha audio yoki videoni tinglab tushunish.
final_exam.goal: B1 darajadagi bilimlarni mustahkamlash va B2 tomon rivojlanish.
